protocol: Pinned Node 24.18.0 on CPU3, three rotated rounds across 23 sources and three roles (207 successful exact-output workers). Prepared API-specific Base data outside clocks. Prepared persistent Base data excludes preparation cost. Fresh processes do not mean an OS-cold filesystem, installed CLI latency, or steady-state throughput.
B1 and B2 have separate fresh campaigns and separate TypeScript samples. The installed compiler is B1; B2 is independently qualified.
The +0.530% B1 and −0.230% B2 paired changes are small descriptive campaign differences, not established optimization gains or regressions.
